ActionDescriptions.ToCaptureDiagnosticDesktopWindowFrameJso:
to diagnose desktop window stream frame payload
Experimental diagnostic action. Captures one frame from one visible application window and returns the typed desktop stream frame JSON payload. This does not open a browser UI, does not start a stream, and does not accept input. The current implementation may restore/foreground the matched window before capture.
processName - process name such as notepad.
windowTitleContains - optional title substring used to disambiguate visible windows.

ActionDescriptions.ToClickDesktopWindowImage:
to click scaled desktop window screenshot point
processName - process name such as notepad.
windowTitleContains - optional title substring.
windowHandle - native window handle returned by ToResolveDesktopWindow and the capture artifact.
x - image-relative X coordinate from the captured screenshot artifact.
y - image-relative Y coordinate from the captured screenshot artifact.
nativeWindowWidth - NativeWindowWidth from the captured screenshot artifact.
nativeWindowHeight - NativeWindowHeight from the captured screenshot artifact.
imageWidth - ImageWidth from the captured screenshot artifact.
imageHeight - ImageHeight from the captured screenshot artifact.
button - mouse button: left, right, or middle.
Do not add screen offsets. The driver revalidates the process/title/handle, verifies current bounds still match the capture, foregrounds the window, and computes native screen coordinates internally.

ActionDescriptions.ToOpenDesktopWindowControl: Compatibility alias for ToOpenExperimentalBlockingDesktopWindowControl. Prefer the experimental blocking name because this tool is not a persistent stream and may repeatedly foreground the matched desktop window while the browser control is open.
ActionDescriptions.ToOpenExperimentalBlockingDesktopWindowC:
to test browser control of a desktop application window
Experimental blocking desktop-window handoff. Opens an interactive browser surface, streams one matched foreground application window, and sends browser mouse/keyboard input back to that desktop window. This is not a detached or persistent stream: the tool call blocks until the user clicks Done/Cancel/Close or the timeout expires. The current implementation repeatedly restores/foregrounds the target window while active, so use only for controlled manual validation.
processName - process name such as notepad.
windowTitleContains - optional title substring.
frameIntervalMs - desktop stream frame interval.
timeoutSeconds - maximum seconds to wait for the browser to close the control.

ActionDescriptions.ToViewDesktopWindowInteractiveSite:
to watch a selected application window
Launch the registered Desktop Viewer component for one exact visible window selected from ToListVisibleDesktopWindows.
processName - exact ProcessName from the inventory.
windowTitle - exact WindowTitle from the inventory.
frameIntervalMs - frame interval from 100 through 5000 milliseconds.
timeoutSeconds - maximum interactive-site lifetime; the general Done/Close mechanism may exit earlier.

Prompt/routing skill for provider-neutral desktop and browser interaction. It teaches the active selected-model session how to combine BrowserSession and Desktop primitives without launching a nested model runner.
